_comment: Guided puzzle solutions for FINAL FANTASY (src/core/field/puzzle_guide.cpp). Map ids are the map master's (tools/mapdump/ff1_master/map.txt); cells are baked tile coordinates (tools/mapdump/ff1_objects.jsonl). Authored 2026-10-10 from the dumps; not yet tested in game.

puzzles._about: The teleporter maze: 1F pad -> 2F point 1; the 2F pads (sc_war_30071_N: ChangeMap [94, N]) jump between the floor's numbered points; the 2F stairs at (33,32) lead to 3F, where the return pad at (29,29) sits by the throne. The router takes the pads as warp edges, so one destination suffices.
